description: Head-movement mini-game G13, opening Group C: find-the-direction game. Voice cues one direction per trial (8 fixed trials: left, down, right, up, right, left, up, down) and the screen shows the same arrow; turn to it and hold 0.8 s to find it, then return to center before the next cue. Wrong direction is an instant miss; no correct direction within 4 s is a miss. Dual-axis start calibration (look down, turn left) learns both signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: find-target
